currentArchiveOrder: SELECTED -> all selected symbols marked used
QUALIFIED_NOT_SELECTED -> only sampled up to 6/pool marked used
NEAR_MISS -> only diagnostics top12, then sampled up to 6/pool marked used
REJECTED_AFTER_BASE -> only sampled up to 6/pool marked used
BROAD_CONTROL -> any feature row not in used and meeting history/price/primary-liquidity filters

structuralBug.rootCause: used tracks serialized sample membership, not semantic population membership.
consequences: Unsampled QUALIFIED_NOT_SELECTED rows remain eligible for BROAD_CONTROL.
Unsampled setup-first-failure rows can remain eligible for BROAD_CONTROL.
Unsampled basePassed=true rejected rows can remain eligible for BROAD_CONTROL.
Thus BROAD_CONTROL can contain rows whose true Formal state belongs to another cohort.

fixedSyntheticWitnesses.setup: 10 GENERAL rows pass scoreCandidate, 3 selected. QUALIFIED_NOT_SELECTED sampler keeps only 6 of remaining 7.
fixedSyntheticWitnesses.consequence: The seventh true qualified row is not in used and can be selected into BROAD_CONTROL if it meets history/price/minLots filters.

fixedSyntheticWitnesses.setup: 20 GENERAL basePassed=true rows fail the same downstream gate; old REJECTED_AFTER_BASE keeps only first 6.
fixedSyntheticWitnesses.consequence: 14 unsampled rejected rows are not in used and can be hash-sampled into BROAD_CONTROL.

fixedSyntheticWitnesses.setup: More setup-first-failure rows exist than diagnostics top12/per-pool archive limits.
fixedSyntheticWitnesses.consequence: Rows not represented by nearSymbols/used can enter BROAD_CONTROL despite being technical near/setup rejects.

interpretationImpact: BROAD_CONTROL is currently a residual unsampled pool, not a guaranteed semantic ordinary/control population.
Selected-vs-BROAD_CONTROL outcome differences can be attenuated or distorted by Formal-qualified/rejected contamination.
BROAD_CONTROL cohort counts cannot be interpreted as disjoint population counts.
Deterministic hashing remains outcome-free but does not cure semantic contamination.

safeRepair.principle: Classify semantic state for every feature row first; sample within disjoint semantic populations second.
minimumExclusionFromBroadControl: all scored/ok=true symbols whether sampled or not
all setup-first-failure symbols whether sampled or not
all basePassed=true downstream-rejected symbols whether sampled or not
all dedicated early-reject cohorts when a dedicated control is intended
safeRepair.alternative: Define BROAD_CONTROL explicitly as rows whose scoreCandidate result is neither ok nor in any dedicated comparison population, with a frozen eligibility contract. Do not use sample membership as semantic membership.
safeRepair.denominator: Persist full semantic population counts by scanDate/pool before bounded sampling.

falsification: Measure historical/prospective contamination rate by re-running scoreCandidate on stored BROAD_CONTROL PIT snapshots only where source-complete; if zero prospectively after a repair, verify with tests rather than assume.
If prior BROAD_CONTROL contains ok=true rows, those dates are contaminated for Selected-vs-BROAD_CONTROL inference and must be flagged/quarantined rather than silently relabeled.
If contamination is negligible prospectively because population sizes are always below caps, repair may have low empirical impact but semantic correctness still matters.
Do not retroactively move immutable rows between cohorts without a versioned quality overlay.

governance.researchArchiveRepair: Potential Class A if only Shadow classification/sampling changes, no market calls, no Formal mutation, and frozen Formal outputs remain identical.
governance.historicalRepair: Append-only/versioned quality overlay; never mutate old snapshots to hide original capture.
governance.formalImpact: NONE unless someone later tries to use the research conclusion to change gates; such changes remain Class C.
